baseline_facts.content: Patient's name is Jack Armani.
Date of birth is 12 August 1958.
The patient could not move the left arm upon waking about an hour ago.
Patient reports no pain in the arm.
Patient reports no discoloration in the hand.
Patient reports the hand does not feel cold.
Patient denies symptoms in the left leg.
Patient reports tingling on the left side of the face since waking.
Patient reports difficulty swallowing.
Patient reports difficulty with speech.
Patient reports this has not happened before.
Patient did not sleep in an awkward position the previous night.
Patient lives alone.
Patient is currently alone at home.
Patient used to smoke.
Patient drinks beer in pints.
Patient has a few alcoholic drinks over the weekend.
Patient has a couple of alcoholic drinks during the week.
Patient has type 2 diabetes.
Patient has high blood pressure.
Patient takes metformin.
Patient takes losartan.
Patient takes amlodipine.
Patient reports allergy to penicillin.
Patient's father has heart disease.
Patient reports no facial asymmetry.
At the time of reporting, the patient still cannot move the left arm.
Patient reports speech is getting a bit harder.
Doctor expressed concern that the symptoms may indicate a stroke.
An ambulance is on its way to the patient's home.
Patient was advised to leave the front door unlocked.
Patient was advised to sit in the hallway by the front door.
Doctor advised emergency hospital assessment.
